correctness.notes: State machines well-defined, localStorage interactions properly wrapped in try/catch, FIFO eviction correct

readability.notes: Clear naming, logical file organization, consistent patterns with existing codebase

maintainability.notes: Hooks are self-contained with single responsibility, proper cleanup in useEffect returns

security.notes: No injection vectors, localStorage access guarded, no sensitive data stored

performance.notes: Debounced save (1500ms) prevents excessive writes, history capped at 50 entries, proper memoization with useCallback

accessibility.notes: Export dialog has focus trap, aria-modal, aria-labelledby; status indicators use text not icons alone
